stemMd: The mean of six values is 12. A seventh value of 19 is added. What is the new mean?
explanationMd: The original total is 72. Adding 19 gives 91 across seven values, so the mean is 13. Averaging 12 and 19 would weight six observations as only one.

distractorRationale.a: Assumes a new value above the mean leaves it unchanged.
distractorRationale.d: Averages the old mean and new value equally.
distractorRationale.c: Uses the wrong new number of observations.
